description: Research and compile a list of suitable venues in Edinburgh with key details such as name, location, capacity, price, and amenities.
success_criterion: A list of at least 3 venues with complete details including name, address, capacity, price range, and key features.

description: Select the most appropriate venue based on standard event criteria such as central location, good reviews, and reasonable cost.
success_criterion: A single venue selected with justification for its suitability.

description: Create a professional flyer using the selected venue's details, including key features, contact information, and event highlights.
success_criterion: A complete flyer draft with all necessary venue information and promotional content.
